blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. This static paradigm cannot adapt to different resource constraints at inference time, and yields suboptimal quality-cost tradeoff by devoting the same effort to both plain backgrounds and intricate details. We propose BudgetPix, an adaptive tokenization framework that dynamically allocates compute based on visual complexity and spatial layout, enabling flexible computational budgeting at inference time. BudgetPix comprises three key components: (1) an adaptive encoder that maps a fixed-size image to a variable-length token sequence using an entropy-guided quadtree alongside a multi-scale patch embedder; (2) a scale-aware decoder reconstructs fixed-resolution images from multi-scale token sets; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule that enables pixel-space denoisers to operate across variable token counts. BudgetPix seamlessly integrates with existing pixel-space diffusion architectures, enabling a single checkpoint to be operated at a wide range of compute budgets. Evaluated on text-to-image generation, BudgetPix matches the fidelity of MiniT2I-L at $512^2$ and PixelDiT at $1024^2$ using just 25% of the original compute budget. In class-conditional generation using a MeanFlow backbone, BudgetPix requires merely 60% of the full compute budget to produce images with near-zero quality degradation, observing a marginal 0.8-point increase in FID. Comprehensive assessments by human and VLM judges confirm that BudgetPix establishes a significantly improved quality-efficiency tradeoff over prior budget-adaptive baselines. More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) have established a new standard for image generation. While most architectures operate in the latent space of a pretrained autoencoder ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , emerging pixel-space DiTs ( Li & He, 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) process raw pixels directly, bypassing the reconstruction ceiling and eliminating the reliance on a separate tokenizer. However, this architectural purity introduces a severe computational bottleneck: the uniform tokenization. Because self-attention scales quadratically with the number of tokens, pixel-space models incur massive computational costs. Furthermore, because this grid resolution is hardcoded during training, the inference cost becomes rigidly fixed. A deployed model cannot scale down to accommodate resource-constrained edge devices, nor can it dynamically adjust to varying user latency requirements, without undergoing entirely separate retraining.
blocks.zh: 分化变形器(DiTs)(Peebles & Xie,2023年)建立了图像生成的新标准. 虽然大多数建筑都运行在被预先训练出自编码器(Rombach等,2022年)的潜在空间中,正在形成的像素-空间 DiTs(Li & He,2026年;Yu等,2026年)直接处理生像素,绕过重建天花板并消除了对单独的活化剂的依赖. 然而,这种建筑的纯度引入了严重的计算瓶颈:统一地表示. 由于自留心量以符数为四倍,像素-空间模型会产生巨大的计算成本. 此外,由于这种网格分辨率在训练期间是硬编码的,推论成本变得僵硬地固定. 部署的模式不能缩小规模以容纳受资源限制的边缘设备,也不能在不进行完全分开的再培训的情况下,动态地调整以适应不同的用户延迟要求。

blocks.en: This static uniform tokenization is fundamentally misaligned with how visual data is structured. Information density varies significantly within images: a cloudless sky offers minimal visual entropy, while heavily textured objects demand the capture of high-frequency details. Forcing a uniform grid to blindly spend identical compute across both regions creates severe computational waste. As shown in Figure 2 a, standard MiniT2I ( Wang et al., 2026b ) wastes 1,024 tokens rendering a simple flag against an open sky, whereas our content-adaptive framework reconstructs the scene perfectly with just 307 tokens (Figure 2 b). Even for complex, edge-to-edge textures like a jackfruit–which strictly requires 256 tokens in standard JiT ( Li & He, 2026 ) (Figure 2 c)–BudgetPix matches the baseline visual quality while cutting the required token budget by 50% (Figure 2 d).
blocks.zh: 这种静态统一符号化在本质上与视觉数据的结构错配. 图像内部的信息密度相差很大:一无云的天空提供最小的可视质素,而大量纹理的物体则需要捕获高频细节. 强制统一电网在两个区域盲目地使用相同的计算结果,造成了严重的计算浪费。 如图2a所示,标准的MiniT2I(Wang等,2026b)浪费了1 024个使一面简单的旗子对开天空的标志,而我们的内容适应框架仅用307个标志完美地重建了场景(图2b)。 甚至对于复杂而边缘到尖端的纹理来说,就像一棵花果 — 这在标准JiT(Li & He, 2026) (图2 c) 中严格需要256个令牌 — 预算Pix 匹配基线视觉质量,同时将所需的令牌预算削减了50%(图2 d).

blocks.en:
Content-adaptive tokenization is well established in discriminative vision models via token merging ( Bolya et al., 2023 ) , token pruning ( Rao et al., 2021 ) , or dynamic multi-scale representations ( Beyer et al., 2023 ; Dehghani et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Choudhury et al., 2026 ) .
However, extending this paradigm to generative models introduces a fundamental challenge. While discriminative models dynamically allocate tokens over an already-provided input image to predict a class label ( Choudhury et al., 2026 ) , generative denoisers must dynamically allocate compute over an image that is actively being generated . This creates a chicken-and-egg dilemma: the denoiser must gauge the local spatial complexity of the image before the image content itself has fully materialized.
blocks.zh:
通过符号合并(Bolya等,2023年),符号推敲(Rao等,2021年),或动态多尺度表示,在歧视性视觉模型中,内容适应符号化得到了很好的确立。 (Beyer等,2023;Dehghani等,2023;Kim等,2025;Choudhury等,2026).
然而,将这种范式扩大到基因模型带来了根本性的挑战。 虽然歧视模型在已经提供的输入图像上动态地分配符号来预测一个类标签(Choudhury等,2026年),但基因贬义者必须动态地对正在积极生成的图像进行计算。 这造成了鸡蛋两难:在图像内容本身完全实现之前,denoiser必须测量图像的局部空间复杂性.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose BudgetPix, a framework that adapts any pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformer into a compute-adaptive image generator. BudgetPix introduces three novel components. First, an entropy-driven encoder maps images into variable-length sequences of multi-scale tokens. Second, A complementary decoder reconstructs these variable-length token sequences into predetermined, fixed-resolution images. Finally, a training and inference strategy, coupled with content-layout augmentation, enables standard checkpoints–originally trained on fixed token budgets–to become dynamically adjustable during inference. Our extensive experiments (Section 4.3 ) demonstrate that BudgetPix can be integrated seamlessly with established pixel-space architectures–including JiT ( Li & He, 2026 ) , MiniT2I ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , and MeanFlow ( Geng et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) –and provide a significantly-better quality-efficiency tradeoff (see plots in Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出"预算Pix"(PresidentPix),这个框架可以使任何预先训练的像素-空间扩散变压器被改造为计算适应图像生成器. 预算 Pix引入了三个小说部分. 首先,一个由 en驱动的编码器将图像映射成多相阶符的可变长序列. 其次,一个互补的解码器将这些可变长的符号序列重建为预先确定的,固定分辨率的图像. 最后,一项培训和推论战略,加上内容推开的扩充,使标准检查站(最初接受过固定符号预算培训)在推论期间能够动态地调整。 我们的广泛实验(第4.3节)表明,预算Pix可以与既定的像素-空间架构无缝地融合,包括JiT(Li & He, 2026),MiniT2I(Wang等, 2026b),PixelDiT. (Yu等人, 2026年),和MeanFlow(Geng等人, 2026年;Lu等人, 2026年) ——并提供显著提高质量效率的取舍(见第4.3节的地块)。

blocks.en: We evaluate BudgetPix on class-conditional and text-to-image pixel-space diffusion models from 256 2 256^{2} to 1024 2 1024^{2} resolution. Under strict low-compute budgets where prior budget-adaptive methods undergo catastrophic collapse, BudgetPix degrades gracefully, preserving high perceptual quality. For class-conditional generation, BudgetPix synthesizes coherent, high-quality images using as little as 10% of the original compute budget (Figure 1 , top 3 rows)–a regime where competing methods fail entirely (cf. Figure 6 ). This robustness mirrors phenomena observed in lossy image compression, where visual data can be heavily down-sampled without significant perceptual degradation.
blocks.zh: 我们从256 2 256\2}到1024 2 1024\2}的解析度来评估预算Pix的类条件和文本到图像像素的空间传播模型。 根据严格的低计算预算,即以往的预算调整方法发生灾难性崩溃,预算Pix优雅地降解,保持了高能见度的质量。 对于类条件生成,PatricPix用不到最初计算预算的10%(图1,前3行)来合成连贯而高品质的图像,这是竞争方法完全失败的制度(参见图6). 这种强性反射出在失落图像压缩中观察到的现象,在那里可以大量地下取样视觉数据,而不会发生重大的知觉退化.

blocks.en: Quantitatively, for text-to-image generation, BudgetPix matches the fidelity of full-compute baselines while utilizing only 25% of the original token budget, achieving GenEval scores of 0.874 0.874 (vs. 0.882 0.882 ) on MiniT2I-L at 512 2 512^{2} , and 0.725 0.725 (vs. 0.721 0.721 ) on PixelDiT at 1024 2 1024^{2} . For class-conditional generation, integrating BudgetPix into a MeanFlow ( Lu et al., 2026 ) backbone allows the model to operate at merely 60% of the original compute budget with negligible degradation in visual quality, observing a minimal FID increase of only 0.81 0.81 points (from 2.65 2.65 to 3.46 3.46 ). Finally, comprehensive evaluations by both human and Vision-Language Model (VLM) judges confirm that BudgetPix achieves a better quality-efficiency tradeoff compared to existing budget-adaptive methods.
blocks.zh: 在数量上,对于文本到图像生成,预算Pix与完全计算基线的忠实性相匹配,同时只利用了原代号预算的25%,在MiniT2I-L上的GenEval分数为0.874(vs. 0.882 0.882)以512 2 512^{2}和在PixelDiT上的0.725(vs. 0.721 0.721)以1024 2 1024^{2}. 对于类条件生成,将"预算Pix"整合为"平面"(Lu等,2026年)主干线使得该型号仅能以原始计算预算的60%运行,视觉质量可忽略不计地降解,观测到最小的FID增长只有0.810.81分(从2.65 2.65分到3.46 3.46分). 最后,人与远景-语言模型(VLM)法官的综合评价证实,与现有的预算调整方法相比,预算ix实现了更好的质量效率取舍。

blocks.en: Our primary contributions are: • We propose BudgetPix, a novel compute-adaptive tokenization framework for pixel-space image diffusion, designed to integrate smoothly into diverse pixel-based diffusion architectures such as JiT, MiniT2I, PixelDiT, and MeanFlow. • BudgetPix introduces three novel components: (1) an entropy-based encoder mapping images into variable-length sequences of multi-scale tokens; (2) a specialized decoder reconstructing fixed-resolution images from these tokens; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule supporting denoisers to operate across continuously variable token counts. • Comprehensive experiments show that BudgetPix achieves an effective quality-efficiency tradeoff compared with alternative adaptive denoising methods.

blocks.en:
For several years the cost of resolution was handled by
not paying it: latent diffusion generates inside a pretrained autoencoder ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , at the price of a reconstruction ceiling and a second training stage.
To manage this, early pixel-space models relied on U-Nets that omitted attention except at the lowest resolutions, before advancing to cascaded models ( Ho et al., 2022 ) , single models with resolution-shifting noise schedules ( Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2025 ) , and finally, hierarchical transformers ( Crowson et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . The most recent line drops the
hierarchy altogether: JiT ( Li & He, 2026 ) and PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2026 ) denoise large patches
with a plain transformer and a narrow patch embedding, matching latent-model quality at the same sequence length.
While this approach offers simplicity, it relies on a single uniform patch grid where size rigidly fixes the computational cost of every step. It also introduces a known weakness in decoding large patches, which PixelDiT addresses
with a second pixel-level stage and PixNerd resolves with a per-patch neural field ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
We adapt a released model of exactly same architecture with AdaLN conditioning ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) trained via flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) settings and classifier-free guidance ( Ho & Salimans, 2021 ) utilized during inference .

Non-uniform, layout-based token reduction first emerged for discriminative vision tasks within pretrained transformers ( Bolya et al., 2023 ; Rao et al., 2021 ; Liang et al., 2022 ; Yin et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) , and later as
tokenization proper, through flexible patch sizes and content-following tokenizers ( Beyer et al., 2023 ; Dehghani et al., 2023 ; Lew et al., 2024 ; Ronen et al., 2023 ; Havtorn et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . Adapting such strategies remains difficult for generation, because a denoiser must write an image through the layout and no image exists when
the layout is chosen. Adaptive work here has therefore stayed off the input grid, varying what is
updated or cached along the trajectory ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Bolya & Hoffman, 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) ,
varying patch size uniformly over the image ( Anagnostidis et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , or
retraining a latent tokenizer ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent with us, RTI ( Zamfir et al., 2026 ) adapts a frozen pixel-space model using LoRA to consume region tokens. In contrast, our method, BudgetPix, plugs in our adaptive encoder and decoder, fully fine-tunes the entire checkpoint to accept variable-sized inputs starting from the first block, and derives the layout from the model’s own estimate of the clean image rather than its internal features.

blocks.en:
BudgetPix is designed to adapt existing pixel-space diffusion transformers into compute-adaptive image generators. As shown in Figure 3 , it consists of three core components: an encoder that compresses images into variable-length, multi-scale token sequences (Sec. 3.2 ), a complementary decoder that reconstructs these token sequences back to fixed-resolution images (Sec. 3.3 ), and a unified training and inference strategy (Sec. 3.4 ).
By replacing the uniform tokenization of standard baselines with this content-adaptive pipeline, BudgetPix enables existing diffusion backbones to seamlessly process flexible token counts and adjust their computational budget based on visual complexity.

预算Pix旨在将现有的像素-空间扩散变压器改造为可计算适应的图像生成器. 如图3所显示,它由三个核心部分组成:一个将图像压缩成可变长,多尺度的符号序列(Sec. 3.2)的编码器,一个将这些符号序列重建回固定分辨率图像(Sec. 3.3)的互补解码器,以及一个统一的培训和推论策略(Sec. 3.4).
通过用这种内容适应的管道来取代标准基线的统一象征性化,预算Pix使现有的扩散主干线能够无缝地处理灵活的符号计数,并根据视觉复杂性来调整其计算预算.

blocks.en: 3.2 BudgetPix Encoder: Embed Non-Uniform Patches
blocks.zh: 3.2 预算Pix编码器:嵌入非统一补丁

blocks.en: Non-Uniform Layout Construction: The image layout determines the spatial partition of the image–specifically, which regions maintain the base p × p p\!\times\!p patch resolution and which are merged into larger patches to be encoded as a single token. Because visual complexity is spatially non-uniform, fine details concentrate on specific regions while homogeneous areas ( e.g. , sky or a plain wall) contain minimal information. Inspired by APT ( Choudhury et al., 2026 ) , we construct this non-uniform layout based on local intensity entropy. The layout is computed from the image during both training and inference. During training, it is derived directly from the ground-truth image x x . At inference, because the clean image is unavailable, the model initially runs a few warm-up denoising steps on a uniform p × p p\times p grid to generate a predicted image x ^ \hat{x} , which is then used to estimate the content-adaptive layout.

blocks.en: Figure 5: BudgetPix Architecture. The encoder receives the noisy input z t z_{t} and its corresponding spatial layout L L , converts the image into a sequence of multi-scale patches. The finest p × p p\times p tokens route directly through the fine path, while coarser patches navigate a dedicated coarse path in both the encoder and decoder. In the encoder, each coarse patch undergoes simultaneous downscaling (to p × p p\times p ) and splitting via a Patch Aggregator (into n 2 n^{2} sub-patches). These streams are processed through MLP layers and a scale mixer before being fused into a single coarse token. In the decoder, each denoised coarse patch is upscaled back to its target resolution ( n ​ p × n ​ p np\times np ). Concurrently, a Patch Refiner splits the patch into 4 × 4 4\times 4 sub-patches, processes them through an MLP and a lightweight transformer, and fuses them with the upscaled patch to restore local texture. The central diffusion transformer is directly initialized from existing pixel-space models, modified only to operate across variable, dynamically determined token counts rather than a fixed count.

blocks.en: 3.3 BudgetPix Decoder: Decoding Multi-scale Image Patches
blocks.zh: 3.3 预算ix解码器:解码多比例图像补丁

blocks.en: The BudgetPix decoder receives the output token sequence from the central transformer–where each token corresponds to a specific patch in the non-uniform spatial layout–and reconstructs them into pixel-space patches at their designated scales. These reconstructed patches subsequently tile together to form the final predicted image x ^ \hat{x} . Specifically, the decoder maps the latent token 𝐡 i \mathbf{h}_{i} , corresponding to a patch P i P_{i} of scale s = n ​ p s=np , back into an n ​ p × n ​ p np\times np pixel space patch P ^ i ( s ) \hat{P}^{(s)}_{i} .
blocks.zh: PresidentPix解码器接收中央变压器输出符号序列——其中每个符号对应非统一空间布局中的特定补丁——并按指定比例将其重建为像素-空间补丁. 这些重建的补丁随后会拼接在一起, 形成最终预测的图像 x\\ \ hat{ x} 。 具体地说,解码器映射了潜在符号 h i\ mathbf{h}_{i},对应了比例尺 s = n s=i}的补丁 P i_{i},回到了 n p× np\ times np 像素空间补丁 P ^ (s)\hat{ (s)}_{i}.

blocks.en: To reconstruct tokens of varying scale back into pixel space, the decoder (Figure 5 , right) mirrors the dual-path architecture of the encoder. The fine path processes base tokens ( n = 1 n\!=\!1 ): a pretrained decoding head maps the latent token 𝐡 i \mathbf{h}_{i} directly into a p × p p\times p pixel patch P ^ i ∈ ℝ p × p × C \hat{P}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{p\times p\times C} , where C = 3 C=3 represents the RGB image channels. The coarse path handles larger tokens ( n > 1 n>1 ). Initially, the main stream decodes the token and bilinearly upsamples the output P ^ i \hat{P}_{i} to the target resolution of n ​ p × n ​ p np\times np , denoted as resize n ​ p ​ ( P ^ i ) \mathrm{resize}_{np}(\hat{P}_{i}) . While this main stream successfully recovers the region’s low-frequency structural layout, the resulting patch is inherently over-smoothed, lacking internal high-frequency textures. To resolve this, a localized secondary stream–the Patch Refiner ( PR s \mathrm{PR}_{s} )–generates and injects the missing high-frequency details as an additive residual: P ^ i ( s ) = resize n ​ p ​ ( P ^ i ) + PR s ​ ( split ⁡ ( P ^ i ) , 𝐡 i ) , \hat{P}^{(s)}_{i}=\mathrm{resize}_{np}\big(\hat{P}_{i}\big)+\mathrm{PR}_{s}\big(\mathrm{split}(\hat{P}_{i}),\mathbf{h}_{i}\big), (2) where P ^ i \hat{P}_{i} is the base patch from the pretrained head; on the fine path the resize is the identity and the residual is absent. The refiner is a lightweight transformer that stays inside one coarse token: it embeds 4 × 4 4\times 4 sub-patches split ⁡ ( P ^ i ) \mathrm{split}(\hat{P}_{i}) , adds local positional embeddings 𝐞 pos \mathbf{e}_{\mathrm{pos}} , processes the sequence with two self-attention layers under adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) conditioned on 𝐡 i \mathbf{h}_{i} , which brings the token’s global context into the local details, and projects the result linearly to the n ​ p × n ​ p np\times np residual. Because it runs on short, local token sequences, its cost per token does not grow with image resolution, and it adds only ∼ 1 % {\sim}1\% to the parameter count.

blocks.en: Layout Augmentation: To ensure the transformer can reliably process sequences of varying lengths, we dynamically assign one of three distinct layout types to each image during training. Let Q ⁡ ( ⋅ , τ + δ ) Q(\cdot,\tau+\delta) represent the entropy quadtree defined by thresholds τ s + δ \tau_{s}+\delta , and let H ⁡ ( x ) H(x) denote the true entropy map of the training image x x . Uniform layout (probability a < 1 a<1 ): The model uses L uniform L_{\mathrm{uniform}} , the standard dense grid of the base architecture. This anchors the training process and prevents catastrophic drift from the pretrained weights. Random layout (probability b b , where a + b < 1 a+b<1 ): The quadtree Q ⁡ ( H ~ , τ + δ ) Q(\tilde{H},\tau+\delta) is applied to a synthetic entropy map H ~ \tilde{H} , where values are drawn uniformly between 0 0 and log 2 ⁡ K \log_{2}K bits per cell. Crucially, this forces coarse tokens to randomly encompass highly detailed image regions. This simulates the constraints of low-budget inference, preventing the model from assuming that coarse tokens only represent flat backgrounds. Content-adaptive layout (probability 1 − a − b 1-a-b ): The standard quadtree Q ⁡ ( H ⁡ ( x ) , τ + δ ) Q(H(x),\tau+\delta) is applied using the actual image entropy map, optimally routing tokens based on true visual complexity. For both the random and content-adaptive quadtree layouts, the global offset δ \delta is randomly sampled for each training image. This ensures the model learns to operate across a continuous range of token counts, scaling from roughly 25% up to 100% of the original dense grid.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: BudgetPix shows that a pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformer’s token count does not need to remain fixed to its pretraining configuration. After one fine-tuning, a single checkpoint serves budgets spanning from a dense grid to a small fraction of it and degrades gracefully where token-merging baselines collapse, even at 1 NFE (Figure 10 ). Its limitations are that the layout is derived from the model’s intermediate predictions, so it can miss details they do not yet show, and that full-resolution stages, such as PixelDiT’s pixel stage, cap the speed-up. Learning where to place tokens, not deriving it from entropy, is a natural next step.

blocks.en:
The released model is the parent as shipped, at its dense grid; the base
model is the released weights run at the same budget through our sampler, without training. ToMe merges tokens by
bipartite soft matching on the image keys before RoPE, averaged over heads (size-weighted, with proportional attention and
the same r r in every block; condition tokens, text or JiT’s in-context class tokens, are never merged). FeatSim makes one similarity merge down to B B tokens early in the network (block 3 on
MiniT2I). Both wrap the released weights, keep the sampler on the dense grid, and on MiniT2I write the merged tokens
back to the dense grid for the last two blocks. RTI runs its released adapter (40k steps), which exists for MiniT2I-B
and MiniT2I-L only. On PixelDiT ours is compared with the base model. Every method of a parent shares the prompts or
labels, the noise, the solver, the steps, the guidance and the attention arithmetic.

conditions, which every method of a parent shares.
